description: Keep values rebuilt on every render, such as filter or map results and the props object, out of effect, memo and callback dependency arrays.

violation.message: $X is a new array from $M() on every render, so this $HOOK $HVERB each time; build $X inside useMemo, or depend on the values it is built from.
$X is a new object from $M() on every render, so this $HOOK $HVERB each time; build $X inside useMemo, or depend on the values it is built from.
$P is a new object each time the parent renders, so this $HOOK $HVERB with it; destructure the $P fields it uses above the hook and list those instead of $P.
$P is a new object each time the parent renders, so this $HOOK rarely reuses its result; destructure the $P fields it needs above the hook, then pass and list those.
